subject: Science
learning_goal: Master the chapter content using source-grounded explanations, practice and revision.

sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: Adolescence: A Stage of Growth and Change 6 The journey of a plant generally begins with the germination of a seed.
sections.source_evidence: Adolescence: A Stage of Growth and Change 6 The journey of a plant generally begins with the germination of a seed.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: With proper nourishment, the seed becomes a sapling and matures into a young plant.
sections.source_evidence: With proper nourishment, the seed becomes a sapling and matures into a young plant.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: This journey is marked by some specific changes.
sections.source_evidence: This journey is marked by some specific changes.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: Some of the visible changes are an increase in its height, the appearance of more leaves, and the development of flowers, fruits, and new seeds.
sections.source_evidence: Some of the visible changes are an increase in its height, the appearance of more leaves, and the development of flowers, fruits, and new seeds.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: It is quite unlikely that a seedling will develop the capabilities to produce its own seeds immediately after germination.
sections.source_evidence: It is quite unlikely that a seedling will develop the capabilities to produce its own seeds immediately after germination.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: It needs to grow and reach maturity to become capable of producing seeds.
sections.source_evidence: It needs to grow and reach maturity to become capable of producing seeds.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: Similarly, animals also need to grow and reach maturity before they can reproduce.
sections.source_evidence: Similarly, animals also need to grow and reach maturity before they can reproduce.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: Some animals lay eggs that hatch into young ones, while others, like humans, directly give birth to young ones.
sections.source_evidence: Some animals lay eggs that hatch into young ones, while others, like humans, directly give birth to young ones.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: In both cases, the young ones gradually grow in size and develop over time.
sections.source_evidence: In both cases, the young ones gradually grow in size and develop over time.

sections.heading: Learning Point 10
sections.content: Curiosity | Textbook of Science | Grade 7 74 The journey of life of a human can be divided into different stages—infancy, childhood, adolescence, adulthood, and old age.
sections.source_evidence: Curiosity | Textbook of Science | Grade 7 74 The journey of life of a human can be divided into different stages—infancy, childhood, adolescence, adulthood, and old age.

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: Each person experiences these stages at their own pace, and the duration of each stage may vary from one individual to another.
sections.source_evidence: Each person experiences these stages at their own pace, and the duration of each stage may vary from one individual to another.

sections.heading: Learning Point 12
sections.content: From infancy to adulthood, our bodies undergo various changes.
sections.source_evidence: From infancy to adulthood, our bodies undergo various changes.

sections.heading: Learning Point 13
sections.content: Until around 10–12 years of age, most changes are related to height and weight.
sections.source_evidence: Until around 10–12 years of age, most changes are related to height and weight.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14
sections.content: After this, other noticeable changes begin to occur, marking the onset of adolescence.
sections.source_evidence: After this, other noticeable changes begin to occur, marking the onset of adolescence.

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: This is a period of rapid growth and development, typically occurring between the ages of 10–19.
sections.source_evidence: This is a period of rapid growth and development, typically occurring between the ages of 10–19.

sections.heading: Learning Point 16
sections.content: During adolescence, the body prepares for adulthood.
sections.source_evidence: During adolescence, the body prepares for adulthood.

sections.heading: Learning Point 17
sections.content: Humans, like most other living beings, can not reproduce immediately after their birth.
sections.source_evidence: Humans, like most other living beings, can not reproduce immediately after their birth.

sections.heading: Learning Point 18
sections.content: Their bodies need to grow and reach a stage of maturity to be able to reproduce.
sections.source_evidence: Their bodies need to grow and reach a stage of maturity to be able to reproduce.

sections.heading: Learning Point 19
sections.content: As humans grow and develop, they experience significant physical, emotional, and behavioural changes, along with the ability to reproduce.
sections.source_evidence: As humans grow and develop, they experience significant physical, emotional, and behavioural changes, along with the ability to reproduce.

sections.heading: Learning Point 20
sections.content: Some of these changes may be quite clearly observable, while others occur internally and may go unnoticed.
sections.source_evidence: Some of these changes may be quite clearly observable, while others occur internally and may go unnoticed.
